paper_id: Wang et al. - 2013 - OFA An optimistic approach to conquer flip ambiguity in network localization
title: OFA: An optimistic approach to conquer flip ambiguity in network localization
motivation: 现有方法因flip预测高假阳性率错误拒绝大量可靠位置估计，导致性能大幅下降
problem_framing: 将flip ambiguity建模为导致巨大误差或零误差的二值问题，而非连续误差
key_insight: 利用flip导致非零即巨的二元误差特性，可先乐观假设再通过锚骨架一致性检查验证并纠正
method_signature: OFA: 通过全局一致性检查和位置纠正阶段实现乐观定位，含置信度传播与错误源定位机制
evaluation_criteria: 鲁棒定位节点比例、SPEE精度、每节点平均多边测量次数
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 只能纠正单节点flip，无法处理combined flip，且处理该情况会产生指数级开销
evidence_for_taste: flip ambiguity causes either huge error or zero error
simple discarding is conservative and pessimistic
we have to carefully balance two critical requirements
the cost is acceptable in most networks
error handling can only correct the flip of one node
thinking_moves: 将错误源二分为ranging error和flip ambiguity，只处理可消除的flip类
从悲观丢弃转为乐观假设加全局锚骨架一致性验证
通过置信度传播将远处节点的验证信息回溯到flip源头
将翻转重构问题转化为过参考节点的直线拟合与镜像反射
cites_own_work: Liu et al. 2006 - Robust distributed node localization
